name: Tachikawa Sora
source:
An [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Okonomiyaki]okonomiyaki[/url] stand clerk. Due to her lack of cooking skills, Sora is forbidden to cook at the stand, even though she really wants to. Sora is "Part 2" of the stand manager Ruka's headache. (The second part of Ruka's headache is Sayuri)
